display_long_description:
**Your SplatterVault command center, built for Quest.**

SplatterVault is a companion app that gives you full control over your on-demand dedicated game servers without leaving VR. Designed for Seamless Multitasking, it runs as a 2D panel alongside your favorite VR games.

**Features:**
- Launch and manage dedicated game servers in seconds
- Track your credit balance and session usage in real time
- Coordinate with your team — view rosters, matchups, scrims, and practices
- Browse and configure games from the full SplatterVault catalog
- Switch between personal and organization accounts
- Share active sessions with teammates via invite links

**Built for VR players, by VR players.**
SplatterVault powers on-demand dedicated servers for competitive and casual VR gaming. This companion app keeps you connected to your servers and team while you play.

Requires a SplatterVault account at splattervault.com.
